hero.title: Newer models steer more smoothly, and later

findings.figure: {pctlo public_open_loop lat_rate_rms lebowski_877m}–{pcthi public_open_loop lat_rate_rms lebowski_877m}% smoother
findings.text: Newer models steer far more smoothly: every comma model since lebowski changes its steering request {pctlo public_open_loop lat_rate_rms lebowski_877m} to {pcthi public_open_loop lat_rate_rms lebowski_877m}% less on comma's public drives.

findings.figure: +{d public_open_loop lat_best_lag 8d736683_12864 lebowski_877m delta d2} s → +{d public_open_loop lat_best_lag 1365126a_12864 lebowski_877m delta d2} s
findings.text: That smoothness came with delay. Mountain Dew's steering trailed the car's own turning by {d public_open_loop lat_best_lag 8d736683_12864 lebowski_877m delta d2} s more than lebowski's; Flip Flop, the model that replaced it on openpilot master, cut the extra delay to {d public_open_loop lat_best_lag 1365126a_12864 lebowski_877m delta d2} s.

Driving comma's simulated car through its world model, Flip Flop and lebowski stay about as close to the recorded path: on a typical segment Flip Flop is {v public_closed_loop xtrack_4s 1365126a_12864 median cm} cm off after 4 s, lebowski {v public_closed_loop xtrack_4s lebowski_877m median cm} cm. The average favours Flip Flop only because lebowski drifted {max public_closed_loop xtrack_4s lebowski_877m d1} m on one segment.

findings.figure: {lo truck_recovery offcentre_xtrack_4s lebowski_877m,8d736683_12864,1365126a_12864 value d2}–{hi truck_recovery offcentre_xtrack_4s lebowski_877m,8d736683_12864,1365126a_12864 value d2} m
findings.text: On the G-Wagon, pushed half a metre sideways, lebowski, Mountain Dew and Flip Flop end {lo truck_recovery offcentre_xtrack_4s lebowski_877m,8d736683_12864,1365126a_12864 value d2} to {hi truck_recovery offcentre_xtrack_4s lebowski_877m,8d736683_12864,1365126a_12864 value d2} m from the driven path 4 s later, and none is consistently ahead: Flip Flop beat lebowski in {d truck_recovery offcentre_xtrack_4s 1365126a_12864 lebowski_877m wins int} of {d truck_recovery offcentre_xtrack_4s 1365126a_12864 lebowski_877m n int} windows after the push, but in {d truck_recovery heading_xtrack_4s 1365126a_12864 lebowski_877m wins int} of {d truck_recovery heading_xtrack_4s 1365126a_12864 lebowski_877m n int} after a 2° heading error.
